defects.source_says: EO 12415 (48 FR 15117, held text EO_12415.txt) amends EO 12358 sec. 4(b) to read "The Commission shall terminate on December 31,1983." The claim's own judgment_reason and research_rationale give 1983-12-31. 1980-12-31 also precedes EO 12376's own signing (1982-08-05), the parent EO 12358 (1982-04-14) and the cited actor EO 12415 (1983-04-05), so it is impossible on the claim's own sources.

Same source fixes December 31, 1983; whole_order_end must equal the clause first end, which the reasons place at 1983-12-31. The structured end date contradicts the cited source and the claim's narrative.

defects.claim_says: actor EO:12415; the end is the parent's own-terms termination, and the rationale concedes that EO 12415 does not name EO 12376
defects.source_says: Owner ruling 2026-10-21 unnamed-instruments (option C): an order that does not name the target does not end it; the end is the instrument that names it (here EO 12553), with the unnamed event disclosed as an earlier candidate. The claim cites only the strike-and-insert ruling and never reconciles option C; if the end is the parent's own term, the actor is EO 12358 sec. 4(b) as amended, not EO 12415. A corrected claim must address this ruling explicitly.

reasons: Hashes of EO_12376.txt, EO_12415.txt and EO_12553.txt match the claimed text_sha256 values and every quoted span equals the bytes at its offsets. Identity is confirmed: EO 12376 of August 5, 1982, 47 FR 34349, Presidential Commission on Drunk Driving, one operative paragraph raising the EO 12358 sec. 1 membership ceiling from 26 to 28; the one-clause inventory is complete. The parent EO 12358 sec. 4(b) originally ended the Commission one year from April 14, 1982; EO 12415 (April 5, 1983) reset it to December 31, 1983 before that date. Cruden number searches for EO 12376 and EO 12358 found no other held text extending or reviving the Commission. The OFR notes 'Amends: EO 12358' and 'Revoked by: EO 12553, February 25, 1986' are both addressed, and EO 12553's table lists 12376 (offset 26922). Savings analysis is adequate. The claim is rejected because its structured first_end.date and whole_order_end.date are 1980-12-31. That date contradicts the cited EO 12415 text (December 31, 1983) and the claim's own reasons (1983-12-31), and it falls before the order existed. A further defect: the claim names an instrument that does not name EO 12376 as the ending actor without reconciling the 2026-10-21 unnamed-instruments ruling.
